description: Summary figure: method positive control on NDH-2, score benchmark including the new structural relatives, and exposure of the candidate element versus its equivalents in SQLE and GGR
code:
import os, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
R=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'equivalent_region_burial.csv'))
B=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'membrane_docking_benchmark.csv'))
D=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'crtY_residue_membrane_depth.csv'))
N=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'membrane_depth_5NA1.csv')) if os.path.exists(os.path.join(OUT,'membrane_depth_5NA1.csv')) else None

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.3))

# A: positive control, interface localisation in NDH-2 vs CrtY
a=ax[0]
lab=['NDH-2 5NA1\n(known C-terminal anchor)','CrtY model\n(predicted C-terminal element)']
full=[-1.10,-1.70]; trunc=[-0.26,-0.89]
x=np.arange(2); w=0.35
a.bar(x-w/2,full,w,color='#2c3e50',label='full chain')
a.bar(x+w/2,trunc,w,color='#95a5a6',label='C-terminal element deleted')
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8); a.set_ylabel('docking score (kcal/mol per 1000 A2)')
a.set_title('A. Deleting the C-terminal element removes\nmost of the docking signal in both',fontsize=9)
a.legend(fontsize=7); a.axhline(0,color='k',lw=.8)

# B: docking score benchmark with the new structural relatives
a=ax[1]
pts=[('COX-1 1DIY',-2.27,'monotopic'),('SQLE cat. dom. 6C6P',-3.22,'monotopic'),
     ('NDH-2 4G73',-1.76,'monotopic'),('NDH-2 4NWZ',-1.37,'monotopic'),('NDH-2 5NA1',-1.10,'monotopic'),
     ('glutathione reductase',-1.55,'soluble'),('GGR 3ATR',-0.38,'soluble/unknown'),
     ('CrtY P21687 model',-1.70,'query')]
pts=sorted(pts,key=lambda t:t[1])
col={'monotopic':'#c0392b','soluble':'#2980b9','soluble/unknown':'#7f8c8d','query':'#27ae60'}
a.barh([p[0] for p in pts],[p[1] for p in pts],color=[col[p[2]] for p in pts])
a.set_xlabel('docking score (kcal/mol per 1000 A2)'); a.tick_params(labelsize=8)
a.set_title('B. The score does not separate CrtY from\nsoluble controls (red monotopic, blue soluble)',fontsize=9)

# C: exposure of the equivalent regions
a=ax[2]
piv=R.pivot_table(index='region',columns='pdb',values='mean_RSA_isolated')
order=['helix 331-338','C-term 353-382','element 309-382']
piv=piv.loc[order,['CrtY model','6C6P','3ATR']]
piv.columns=['CrtY model','SQLE 6C6P','GGR 3ATR']
piv.plot(kind='bar',ax=a,color=['#27ae60','#8e44ad','#e67e22'],width=.75)
a.set_ylabel('mean relative solvent accessibility'); a.set_xlabel('')
a.set_xticklabels(order,rotation=12,fontsize=8)
a.axhline(0.20,ls='--',color='k',lw=.8); a.text(2.35,0.21,'buried',fontsize=7)
a.set_title('C. CrtY 353-382 is exposed in the model but is\ncore-packed in the closest solved structure',fontsize=9)
a.legend(fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(piv.round(3).to_string())
